faults.what: The door/wall panel changes from a pale pink door to a dark grey flat panel over 105.29-105.36. The white wainscot also pops in at 105.32, covering where the door was. There is no swing in between, so the open reads as a texture and geometry swap. The hand also stays at the same spot in the frame and never visibly pushes.
faults.fix: Animate the door swinging over several frames, or hide the swap with a motion blur or a cover. Match the door's back face and the wainscot so they don't pop.

faults.what: His hand reaches toward the door knob area but does not press on the surface. At 105.29-105.32 the arm hangs in front of the door and the hand seems to be near, not on, the wall. The door opens before any clear touch.
faults.fix: Time the door's opening to the frame where the palm lands. Plant the palm flat on the door.

faults.what: The shirt changes from dark navy (105.22-105.46) to bright purple (105.76 onward). His pants and the lighting also change, and the wall is now white. The character looks recolored, and the framing and scale jump between strips.
faults.fix: Keep the shirt material and lighting consistent through the shot. If it is meant to be a transition, make it clearly a cut or a wipe.

faults.what: The frame blows out to full white at 105.93-105.96 and fades back to a ghost image at 105.99. The white-out starts abruptly, with no ramp from 105.89 to 105.93.
faults.fix: If it is a flash transition, ramp it up over 3-4 frames. Otherwise remove the blown-out frames.

faults.what: His back is to the camera and his head is turned into the dark panel. His arms swing in a mirrored, even way, and his face is hidden. So the 'he has to know' curiosity does not read.
faults.fix: Turn him three-quarters toward the camera, or lead with a head turn so the eyes can be seen.

summary: The push reads as a swap, not a swing: the door goes from pink to a grey panel in about 3 frames, with no clear hand contact. The shirt colour jumps from navy to purple, and the shot ends in an abrupt white-out.
